properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued August 10 at 6:21AM CDT until August 10 at 11:00AM CDT by NWS Kansas City/Pleasant Hill MO
properties.description:
At 621 AM CDT, Doppler radar indicated the strongest storms and
heaviest rain rates have ended. Between 2 and 3 inches of rain have
fallen with the storms this morning. Additional rainfall amounts up
to 0.5 inches are possible in the warned area as rain slowly ends.
Flash flooding is ongoing or expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Flash flooding caused by thunderstorms.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Flash flooding of small creeks and streams, urban areas,
highways, streets and underpasses as well as other poor
drainage and low-lying areas.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Overland Park, Olathe, Leawood, Gardner, Spring Hill, Clare,
Stanley and Stilwell.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

properties.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Warning issued August 10 at 7:59AM EDT until August 10 at 9:00AM EDT by NWS Cleveland OH
properties.description:
SVRCLE

The National Weather Service in Cleveland has issued a

* Severe Thunderstorm Warning for...
Erie County in north central Ohio...
Cuyahoga County in northeastern Ohio...
Northern Lorain County in north central Ohio...

* Until 900 AM EDT.

* At 758 AM EDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from near Western Vermilion to near Wakeman, moving east
at 45 mph.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to trees and power lines.

* Locations impacted include...
Cleveland, Lorain, Elyria, Western Vermilion, Vermilion, Parma,
Lakewood, Cleveland Heights, Strongsville, Westlake, North
Royalton, North Ridgeville, Avon Lake, Amherst, Grafton, North
Olmsted, Garfield Heights, Maple Heights, Avon, and Parma Heights.
properties.instruction:
For your protection move to an interior room on the lowest floor of a
building.

Large hail, damaging wind, and continuous cloud to ground lightning
are occurring with these storms. Move indoors immediately. Lightning
is one of nature's leading killers. Remember, if you can hear
thunder, you are close enough to be struck by lightning.

Torrential rainfall is occurring with these storms, and may lead to
flash flooding. Do not drive your vehicle through flooded roadways.

properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued August 10 at 7:55AM EDT until August 10 at 10:00AM EDT by NWS Cleveland OH
properties.description:
SMWCLE

The National Weather Service in Cleveland has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Nearshore and Open waters from Avon Point OH to Geneva-on-the-lake
OH...

* Until 1000 AM EDT.

* At 754 AM EDT, strong thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from 27 nm northeast of Kelleys Island to 8 nm north of
Lorain Harbor to 6 nm southeast of Huron, moving east at 40 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts to 40 knots and small hail.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Small craft could be damaged in briefly higher winds and
suddenly higher waves.

* Locations impacted include...
Willowick, Fairport Harbor, Geneva-On-The-Lake, and Cleveland.
properties.instruction:
Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.

Frequent lightning is occurring with these storms. If caught on the
open water stay below deck if possible, keep away from ungrounded
metal objects.

properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued August 10 at 8:00AM EDT until August 10 at 8:45AM EDT by NWS Cleveland OH
properties.description:
For the following areas...
Nearshore and Open waters from The Islands OH to Avon Point OH...

At 800 AM EDT, severe thunderstorms capable of producing waterspouts
were located along a line extending from 12 nm northwest of Avon
Point to near Western Vermilion, moving east at 45 knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts, wind gusts to 40 knots, and small hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally
hazardous seas. Small craft could be damaged in briefly
higher winds and suddenly higher waves.

Locations impacted include...
Western Vermilion, Huron, Avon Point, Lorain Harbor, and Vermilion.
properties.instruction:
Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.

Frequent lightning is occurring with these storms. If caught on the
open water stay below deck if possible, keep away from ungrounded
metal objects.
